items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Sidney Beche, Dr. Beche, I knew the dentist, I knew Sidney too.

ctx.x: Yeah, well that was Mr. Glenn, I remember him. I remember this fellow here, Beche.
Sidney Beche, Dr. Beche, I knew the dentist, I knew Sidney too.

Yeah, well he, I remember when my brother was first learning to play clarinet, he used to come and sit right to Calamon and St. Philip in the gutter. He was clarinet to play for me while he was waiting for my brother to come to give him lessons. He was great, he was a great clarinet player.
